title: First lessons: trumpet with Chaligny, clarinet with Papa Tio
summary: His father could not teach him, so he took trumpet lessons from Chaligny at about 15, then switched to clarinet with Papa Tio.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: My dad had started me but he couldn't look like he had no patience to learn to teach me. He sent me to his friend Old Man Shalini. Oh yeah. And I took trumpet lessons. On the trumpet. I took trumpet lessons with Shalini.
And I gave that up and I started playing clannery. I went to Papa Teo.
How old were you when you started?
How old were you? About how big a boy were you when you started? Who me? In music. Oh.
When I started on the trumpet I was about 15 years old. I was about 15 years old. When I started on the trumpet.
Then you took up the clarinet and went to Teo.
Yeah. After I gave that up. Was that Papa Teo?
That's right. Papa Teo. Papa Teo. I went to Papa Teo and I played and I stayed with him until he took sick. Until he took sick.
